description: This file contains shell script functions used for platform-specific setup, upgrade, and check routines for different router or device models in an OpenWrt environment. It includes functions for initializing storage, handling upgrade procedures, and checking images tailored to specific hardware.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI storage if the device is running on initramfs.

methods.name: buffalo_initial_setup
methods.description: Detects MTD partition for ubi and attempts to detach and format it.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI storage, detaches and formats multiple MTD partitions, and optionally sets environment variables based on the device model.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the firmware upgrade process tailored to specific device models and their storage configurations.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs validity checks on firmware images based on device-specific magic or image headers.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration files during upgrade if necessary.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Executes pre-upgrade steps specific to device models, such as initial setup routines.
